title: Read a Position Safely
summary: Handle valid and invalid collection positions explicitly.

contract.input: A collection and a position that may be invalid.
contract.output: The item at a valid position, otherwise no value.

examples.explanation: Position 2 is the final valid position.

constraints: position may be any whole number
commonMistakes: using the collection size as a valid position

blocks.content: Return the item at the supplied zero-based position. Return no value when the position is negative or beyond the last valid position.

blocks.title: safe_item_at(items, position)
blocks.content:
